decision: TypeScript: fallow audit; Dart/Python: jscpd 5 baseline; mutation: Stryker --incremental --mutate <file> for JS/TS, mutmut 3 function wildcards for Python, Dart none; scored functions live in a committed ledger keyed by source hash; public repositories score unscored functions nightly in GitHub Actions on free standard runners and open a pull request with gh + GITHUB_TOKEN; private repositories run locally before push; no mutation inside push or pull-request CI
question: Which tool gates clones, complexity, and CRAP per stack with machine-readable output, which mutation runner per language, how each runner skips already-scored code, and what a nightly GitHub Actions mutation job needs
unknown: Stryker incremental file merge behaviour when two branches touch the same file

whether the repository setting that lets GitHub Actions create pull requests is on for sgaabdu4/hard-eng; github.event.repository.private on a schedule payload, so the job asks the API for visibility instead
verified: fallow audit: changed-file gate over dead code, complexity, duplication; verdict pass/warn/fail with exit code; --max-crap default 30; --coverage coverage-final.json; per-analysis baselines
jscpd 5.1.1: --baseline + --update-baseline create the baseline, --fail-on-new-clones exits 1 on a new pair, console reporter prints [NEW] with both files; observed locally
fallow 3.22.0 audit --format json observed locally: kind=audit, verdict, summary, attribution, complexity.findings rows with path, name, line, introduced
mutmut 3: pytest-only runner, pyproject [tool.mutmut] source_paths + pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection, mutates only called functions, timeout = (original duration + 1) x 15

mutmut docs: mutmut run accepts unix wildcards on mutant names such as mutmut run "module.function*"; mutmut 3.7.0 observed locally writes mutants/<source path>.meta with exit_code_by_key and hash_by_function_name per file

Stryker docs: --incremental (since 6.2) stores results in reports/stryker-incremental.json (--incrementalFile), reuses a killed mutant when its culprit test is unchanged and a non-killed mutant when no covering test changed, --force reruns everything, --mutate <file> limits the mutated files

GitHub docs: schedule event uses POSIX cron in UTC, runs only from the workflow file on the default branch at its last commit, can be delayed at the top of the hour, and is disabled automatically in a public repository after 60 days without activity

GitHub docs: GitHub Actions usage is free for public repositories on standard GitHub-hosted runners; private repositories draw from the plan's monthly minutes and are billed beyond them; larger runners are always charged
gh manual: gh pr create --title --body --base --head opens a pull request for the current branch
GitHub docs: GITHUB_TOKEN is passed to gh as GH_TOKEN with job-level permissions such as contents and pull-requests; permissions beyond it need a GitHub App or a personal access token
